summary: The note describes the political history of the party We Sammarinese (We Sanmarinese) around 2011-2012. After the Pact for San Marino government collapsed in 2011 and its component lists dissolved, the party, now fully independent, agreed a federative pact with the Sammarinese Christian Democratic Party and joined a new national unity government. It then ran in the 2012 Sanmarinese election as part of the PDCS, which won.
one_line: We Sammarinese, a San Marino party, joined a federative pact with the Christian Democrats after the 2011 government collapse and ran with them in 2012.
key_facts: In 2011 the Pact for San Marino government collapsed.
The collapse of the Pact for San Marino government caused the disbandment of its component lists.
We Sanmarinese was, at the time described in the note, a fully free party.
We Sanmarinese decided to accept a federative pact with the Sammarinese Christian Democratic Party.
The federative pact led We Sanmarinese to enter a new government of national unity.
We Sanmarinese ran in the Sanmarinese election of 2012 as party of the PDCS.
The PDCS was the ultimately victorious party in the Sanmarinese election of 2012.
The note refers to the party by the abbreviation NS when describing the 2012 election run.
